title: Release Orchestrate Nexus with Home deployment
description: Replace the legacy Orchestrate lane, worktree, and claim deployment with the minimal PathLock-backed Orchestrate Nexus; release the Home consumer unconditionally; regenerate approved Curriculum consumers; obtain Lojix/live acceptance. The legacy state is discarded and not migrated.
design: Preserve only the existing PathLock registration and release behavior. Rename the service executable to orchestrate-nexus while retaining orchestrate and meta-orchestrate clients. Treat deployment as breaking and wait for durable Nix, remote-builder, Home, Lojix, and live witnesses before closeout.
acceptance_criteria: A pushed Orchestrate commit and released Home/Curriculum consumers name Orchestrate Nexus; durable remote-builder checks pass; Lojix and live acceptance are recorded; old durable state is explicitly discarded without migration.
notes: Implementation started 2026-08-26. The deployed Orchestrate coordination socket was unavailable during the initial lane-registration attempt, so no advisory path claim could be registered. Beads is initialized locally and this epic is claimed for the deployment.
